Class ViewGameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.GUI.controllers.ViewGameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
public class ViewGameController extends Object implements UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
Controller for the main in-game screen. It renders the whole board — the four card rows, the central deck/order/offer tiles, the totems, and a per-player dashboard — from the snapshots and incremental updates pushed by the server, and turns local clicks into game requests (totem placement, card picks, skipping the bonus pick).

As an UpdateHandler/MessageVisitor it dispatches each ServerMessage to the matching visit overload. Much of the class is presentation logic: hover tooltips and zoom, pulsing glows on the nodes the local player may currently interact with, and animations for card picks, totem moves, end-of-round/era board shifts and event resolution.

Because some updates arrive while an animation is playing, board-changing actions are funnelled through executeOrDefer(Runnable): they run immediately when idle, or are queued behind the in-flight event animation otherwise, keeping the visible board consistent.
